Supreme Court seeks clarification on CBSE's three-language policy for Class 9

The Supreme Court has sought replies from the Centre, CBSE, and NCERT on pleas against the three-language rule for Class 9. The court has expressed concern over the potential stress it may cause to students. Justice BV Nagarathna suggests introducing a third language in Class 6 instead.
